description: Choose the eBay shipping (fulfillment) policy of ONE product, or with fulfillmentPolicyId null return it to the connection default. A product with no eBay listing stores the choice for its next draft. A draft or LIVE listing has its eBay offer updated in place — no relisting — when listing writes are armed on the eBay connection, and the offer is then read back to confirm; with listing writes off a live listing is refused and a draft stores the choice for go-live. Per-service shipping cost overrides tied to the old policy are removed (droppedShippingCostOverrides). Returns productId, sku, offerId, marketplaceId, previousFulfillmentPolicyId, newFulfillmentPolicyId, status (updated, unchanged, saved, unverified, failed), verified and error — tell the user a listing changed only when status is updated. Refused until the workspace owner switches on AI publishing. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

fulfillmentPolicyId.description: A fulfillmentPolicyId from list_ebay_fulfillment_policies, for the same marketplace. null removes the product's own choice so the connection default (then eBay's first policy) applies.

marketplaceId.description: An eBay MARKETPLACE id such as EBAY_IT — never the eBay connection id. Omit it when the eBay connection sells on one site; the server uses that one. Required when the connection sells on several, unless the product already has an eBay offer (its own site is then used).

productId.description: A product id returned by search_products.

name: set_product_ebay_fulfillment_policy
title: Set a product's eBay shipping policy
